_comment: Checklist structure of Ritu Chopra's HR compliance trackers (claude.ai artifact, tabs 6-8). Status values come from each tab's JSON backup. Regenerate from the artifact when the checklists change.
source: HR compliance trackers — POSH, Labour Codes 2020, Payroll (Ritu Chopra)

categories.title: A. License / Registration
items: Principal Employer Registration Certificate (Form II) — Contract Labour
Pollution Control Board Consent to Establish / Operate (if applicable)

categories.title: B. Policies / Guidelines
items: DPDP — Digital Personal Data Protection Policy
HSE Policy / Manual (mandatory if 50 or more employees)

categories.title: C. Committees
items: Grievance Redressal Committee (mandatory if 20 or more employees)
Works Committee (mandatory if 100 or more employees)
Safety Committee (mandatory if 250 or more employees)
Canteen Committee (mandatory if 250 or more employees)
NGO / External Member appointment on ICC
Election / Constitution of Committee members and validity

categories.title: E. Factory, Health & Safety
items: School Plan No. and approved date
Updation of workers' strength records with factory authorities
Crèche Room (mandatory if 30 or more women / as applicable)
Lunch Room (mandatory if 150 or more employees)
Ambulance Room / OHC (mandatory if 500 or more employees)
First Aid Box — location-wise (1 per 150 employees) with inspection list
Lift Inspection Report (Form-09 with Annexure XX)
Lifting Machine / Chain / Rope / Hoist Inspection (Form-10)
Pressure Vessel and Lift Testing Reports
Stack / Noise / Illumination / Air Ambience / Soil Analysis monitoring reports
Medical tests for employees aged 45 and above
Medical Officer appointment (mandatory up to 500 employees) / Additional Nursing Staff
Fire Drill / Mock Drill / Spill Drill records
PPE Register and PPE Training records
Safety Training records for all workers

categories.title: F. Contractor Records
items: Muster Roll (Form XVI) / Wages Register (Form XVII)
Register of Deductions for Damage or Loss (Form XX)
Reconciliation: Principal Employer Form II strength vs. contractor engaged strength
Reconciliation: Contractor licence strength vs. engaged strength
WC Policy for non-ESI-covered contract workers

categories.title: G. Records & Registers
items: Resignation List / Full & Final Settlement File

categories.title: H. Notice Board / Statutory Displays
items: Name and Address of the Inspector-cum-Facilitator
Notice: date of payment before 7th of the month
Monthly Challan / Payment Receipt — PF, ESIC, PT, LWF
Bonus — Form A, Form B (calculation), Form C (Bonus Payment Register), Form D (Annual Return)
Professional Tax — PTEC and PTRC payment receipts
BOCW Cess Payment (Building and Other Construction Workers, if applicable)
Provisions for Handicapped Employees (PT exemption, certificate on file)
POSH awareness training and NGO tie-up
Salary disbursed before 7th of following month
Apprentice registration and current apprentice count

categories.title: Policy & Awareness
items: Policy displayed prominently on campus and website
All staff informed about POSH policy
Policy includes definition of sexual harassment and redressal mechanism
Regular awareness sessions conducted for staff

categories.title: Internal Committee (IC) Formation
items: IC constituted as per POSH Act requirements
Presiding Officer is a senior female employee
At least 50% women members in IC
External member appointed with relevant experience
IC details displayed on notice boards

categories.title: Training & Capacity Building
items: IC members trained on POSH procedures
New employees oriented on POSH during induction
Documentation of all training sessions maintained

categories.title: Complaint Mechanism
items: Clear process for filing complaints defined
Multiple reporting channels available (email, written, verbal)

categories.title: Inquiry Process
items: Both parties given opportunity to be heard
Recommendations documented and shared with management

categories.title: Record Keeping & Documentation
items: Annual report prepared as per law
Records stored securely with restricted access

categories.title: Student Safety Alignment
items: Child protection policy aligned with POSH principles
Awareness sessions for students on safe/unsafe behavior

categories.title: Audit & Compliance
items: Gaps identified and corrective actions taken

categories.title: 1. Attendance
items: Send reminder to Nayna to check the Exit Pass report (due 5th)
Attendance email to all staff — 1st reminder for Staff/Support Staff to check attendance for the month (due 10th)
Reminder for attendance — send to staff via Nucleus - data for those with pending HRIS applications/approvals (due 10th)
Pull LOP report for Staff/Support Staff (due 24th)

categories.title: 2. Employee Details Checklist
items: Introduce new employee in Grey Software as per legal entity
Upload new employee salary structure in Grey Software as per legal entity
Protego employee: new joinee with salary less than ₹21,000 — check ESIC eligibility
Resign staff/support staff from Grey Software as per legal entity
Upload working days as per legal entity

categories.title: 3.1 Maternity Leave (ML) Cases
items: Employees who will receive ML salary along with the regular payroll cycle
Employees whose ML salary will be generated but not deposited
Employees who have rejoined after ML — hold ML installments to be released along with salary as per attendance

categories.title: 3.3 New Joiners
items: Stop salary for new joinee teachers who have not completed training
Full salary for the month — as per data provided by PCs
Trainee teachers on fixed salary — confirm start month

categories.title: 3.4 Resignation
items: Employees on notice period with dues/pending salary — hold, pending confirmation with Principal

categories.title: 3.5 Interns (if any)
items: Check attendance from respective TL and print invoice accordingly

categories.title: 4. Teacher Training Incentive (applies to FS Report and PSLLP Report)
items: Check all new trainees are added to the month-wise training incentive report
Follow up with TCs to enter incentive % and salary update for the previous month
Update salary percentage and effective date
Verify the generated Incentive Report Payroll against the month-wise Incentive Percentage tab
Verify the generated Incentive working in the Non-Salary Processing file against the Incentive Report Payroll

categories.title: 6. PSLLP Report Checklist
items: Refer to the "Need to Check" sheet to confirm all scenarios are covered

categories.title: 7. GPA and PF Checklist
items: Send mail to generate UAN and PF account number for Support Staff who joined in the current month
Update the UAN and PF account number in Nucleus
Update the UAN and PF account number in Payroll
Mail GPA data for all Staff who joined in the current month, as per legal entity

categories.title: 8. Referral Data Checkpoints
items: Check referral details — 6 months completed? Actually referred by the referee?
Check the new candidate's employee code
Confirm payment status is "No" before processing Pre-ENET data
Check the entry in the Referral Manual Maternity Holdback Working tab

categories.title: 9. Compensation Claim Checklist
items: Verify the processed responses for the current month in the New Compensation Claim Responses sheet
Check that all responses are approved
Verify the generated Compensation Working tab in the Non-Salary Processing File against the New Compensation Claim Responses sheet
Confirm admin training amount to be given
Add held-back percentage to the sheet
Add release percentage to the sheet

categories.title: 10. Final Step — Visiting Faculty (VF) Salary Checklist
items: Process payment as per number of sessions sent in mail
Send mail for attendance approval: Bharatkumar Vashi, Sumeet Shah, Retired employees on service agreement

categories.title: Check the following in the Visiting Faculty Invoice Format 2024-25:
items: Check the calculation and cross-check the generated amount
Check the salary month & year for generating the bill; verify hardcopy of bills generated
Confirm all bills are duly signed before submission to Accounts department
Propel Racquet Academy bill for March — received
Propel Racquet Academy bill for March — checked and submitted to Accounts

categories.title: Payroll
items: Ensure 100% payroll is processed by the 28th of each month, in line with defined payroll cycles, as per the checklist (FS: 1st of every month; FSNC: 5th of every month).
Address and resolve 100% of payroll-related queries within 5 working days of receipt.

categories.title: Legal and Compliance
items: Achieve 100% on-time filing and payment of all statutory obligations (PF, ESI, PT, TDS, etc.) with zero delays each month.
Ensure 100% accuracy in Full & Final settlements, processed within 30 days of an employee’s exit, with zero compliance lapses.
